Great — locked for Mon 31 May @ 14:00 PDT. Calendar invite to follow.

To answer your questions briefly:
- MSA: Legal prefers agreement signature before production provisioning, but we can begin portal setup and internal onboarding tasks (billing profile, vendor records) in parallel. If provisioning needs to start earlier, we can put a controlled sandbox access in place pending MSA execution.
- PO fields: The essentials we need are: PO number, billing address, remit-to info (Redwood Accounts Payable), contact person, and invoice frequency. The attached PO template contains the required Redwood fields for our finance team. Coupa exports are fine — our AP team ingests electronic POs if the required fields are present.

Below is a proposed MAP (mutual action plan) we can finalize on the call — please review and tell me if any owners/dates should change: 
- By Jun 2: Vendor onboarding form completed (owner: Asha / Sapphire)
- By Jun 4: PO issued to Redwood (owner: Sapphire finance)
- By Jun 7: MSA signature routed (owner: Redwood Legal + Sapphire Legal)
- By Jun 9: Billing profile created and AP verification (owner: Rachel Kim / Redwood)
- By Jun 14: Initial capacity provisioned for evaluation (owner: Vivek / Redwood)

Meeting agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Review Sapphire onboarding form & required artifacts (10m)
3) PO process and Coupa/fields (10m)
4) MAP owners & dates + risks (10m)
5) Action items & next steps (5m)

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (PO fields), kickoff-agenda.md (condensed)

Thanks — added notes on the procurement side for the call. Asha, quick checklist items our AP/procurement team will want to confirm during the meeting: 
- Completed vendor onboarding form (W-9 + Tax ID for US entities)
- SOC 2 attestation or statement of controls (or point to audit report)
- Remit-to details and preferred invoice format (PDF vs EDI)
- Invoice routing email and contact person
- Whether Sapphire requires a pre-billing test invoice (some partners do)

Also, for contracting: please let us know your legal contact so we can route the MSA + SOW. If you have any redlines ahead of time, drop them into the DocuSign link so Legal can triage.

I attached our PO template as well (pre-filled with Redwood remit info) — feel free to share with your finance team.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx

See you on the call.

—
Rachel Kim
